subject: Re: APAC connector duplication — credit allocation & India withholding guidance
messages:
From: Arjun Rao <arjun@kartika.ai>
To: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai
Cc: accounts@kartika.ai
Date: 2026-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Unexpected duplicate usage on Sep invoices — request for credit and tax note

Hi Vivek,

Hope you’re well — we found a duplication in our September invoices where a connector was onboarded twice (parent + child account) and ingestion bytes were billed for both. Attached is a sliced export (kartika_usage_export_sep2026.csv) showing identical session IDs billed to two account IDs. Total duplicate spend looks to be ~US$12,540.

Can Redwood issue a retroactive credit for the duplicate usage? Two constraints from our side: (1) the paying entity is the parent company (Kartika Global), but our product team wants the credit applied 70% to the parent invoice and 30% to the child developer account (KART-DEV-02); (2) because payments originate from India, our local tax team will apply 10% TDS (withholding) unless we receive a credit memo suitable for reclaiming withholding tax.

What docs do you need from us to make the credit triangular (split across entities) and to produce tax-friendly evidence we can use with our CA? We’d like a timeline as well — the October invoice is due on 10/20, so speed would be appreciated.

Thanks —
Arjun
VP of Finance, Kartika AI
attachments: kartika_usage_export_sep2026.csv (CSV, 78KB)
From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai

Date: 2026-10-04T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected duplicate usage on Sep invoices — request for credit and tax note

Arjun — thanks for the heads up and for the export. I’ve looped in Rachel (billing) and Marissa (invoicing ops) to validate the usage rows and propose a remediation. Priyom from Solutions is also on copy to help with account mapping so we can apply the credit correctly across your parent/child hierarchy.

Next steps from Redwood:
- Marissa will run a reconciliation against our ingestion logs and confirm the duplicate billing amount.
- We’ll prepare a draft credit memo that can be split per your 70/30 request; let us know the exact child account ID for the 30% allocation (you mentioned KART-DEV-02).
- On the tax side: to produce a credit memo helpful for TDS/GST reclaim, we typically need the paying entity’s tax registration (GSTIN) and a billing contact. If you can share the GSTIN and the legal entity name that appears on payments, Marissa will attach those to the credit memo.

Target: preliminary reconciliation by 10/06, draft credit memo by 10/08 for your review. Will that work for your October invoice cycle?

— Vivek
Head of Customer Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: Vivek K. <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Arjun Rao <arjun@kartika.ai>
Cc: rachel_kim@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-06T10:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected duplicate usage on Sep invoices — request for credit and tax note

Arjun / team — I pulled the rows and verified the duplicate ingestion sessions. Our reconciliation matches your export: duplicate charge = USD 12,540. See attached proposed_credit_schedule_v1.xlsx for the recommended line items and GL codes.

A few operational notes and options:
- We can issue a single credit memo (RWF-3721) for $12,540 and include an allocation schedule that states: Parent (Kartika Global) — 70% ($8,778.00); Child (KART-DEV-02) — 30% ($3,762.00). The credit memo will reference both internal account IDs and your GSTIN if provided.
- Application options: (A) apply credit immediately to October invoices (fastest), or (B) issue a refundable credit payment back to the payer (slower, requires payment method and refund agreement). For October timing, applying to invoices is preferred.
- India withholding (TDS): Redwood does not withhold tax on credits we issue; however, if your vendor accounting team treats the credit as a financial adjustment that affects tax withholding, we can provide an attested credit memo and a short cover letter confirming the adjustment date and amounts. That should be acceptable for your CA to claim TDS credit / adjustment, though your local tax counsel will ultimately confirm.

What we need from Kartika to proceed:
1) Confirm child account ID for the 30% allocation (please confirm KART-DEV-02).
2) Provide paying entity legal name and GSTIN for inclusion on the credit memo.
3) Confirm prefered application option: apply to October invoices (A) or refund payout (B).

If you confirm A and provide GSTIN by end of day 10/07 we’ll update RWF-3721 and schedule application to the 10/20 invoice run.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Senior Billing Specialist, Redwood Inference
attachments: proposed_credit_schedule_v1.xlsx (XLSX, 34KB)
From: Arjun Rao <arjun@kartika.ai>

Subject: Re: Unexpected duplicate usage on Sep invoices — request for credit and tax note

Thanks Marissa — confirmed: KART-DEV-02 is the child account. Paying entity is Kartika Global Pvt Ltd, GSTIN: 27AABCU9603R1ZV. We prefer option A: apply the credit against October invoices so it reduces amounts payable on 10/20.

Regarding TDS/GST: our tax team asked whether Redwood can include a short statement on the credit memo indicating this is a correction of an earlier billing error (retroactive adjustment) and the original invoice numbers being adjusted (if possible). If you can add that wording on the credit memo along with the allocation schedule, we’ll proceed.

I’m attaching a quick note from our CA confirming they can accept Redwood’s credit memo as evidence provided the above wording and GSTIN are present. (attached as CA_note.pdf)

Appreciate the fast turnaround; please confirm when the credit will be reflected.

Best,
Arjun

Arjun — thanks for the confirmation and for sharing the GSTIN and CA note. Per our reconciliation and your preference, we will: 

1) Issue credit memo RWF-3721 for USD 12,540 dated 2026-10-11. The memo will include: reference to the original invoice numbers (INV-2026-09-0412, INV-2026-09-0413), description "retroactive correction for duplicated connector ingestion", allocation schedule (70% parent / 30% child) and Kartika Global Pvt Ltd GSTIN 27AABCU9603R1ZV.

2) Apply the credit to your October invoice run. You should see the adjustments posted to the invoice preview by 10/13 and reflected on the final invoices issued 10/20. Payment due amounts will be reduced accordingly.

3) We will attach a one-page cover letter (signed by Redwood Finance) explaining the nature of the adjustment for TDS reclaim purposes. That, plus the credit memo and the usage export, should give your CA the evidence they asked for.

Marissa / Rachel — please schedule the posting and upload credit_memo_RWF-3721.pdf and the cover letter to the Kartika finance folder in Drive and mark the HubSpot ticket KART-9982 as "credit applied". Priyom — flag any account mapping if you see discrepancies when applying the allocation.

Arjun — I’ll follow up if there are any issues in the posting window, but plan on seeing the credit on the invoice preview by 10/13. Thanks for the clear details which helped speed this.

— Vivek
